sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Nimesh Pathak - advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Ritesh Kumar Sharma -Pl for the State.
 Order

This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.629/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Raoti, District-Ratlam (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 376(3), 376-D of the IPC and sections 5 and 6 of the POCSO Act.

After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application with liberty to renew the prayer after examination of prosecutrix and her parents before the trial court.
The other side has no objection.
With the aforesaid liberty, M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.

Trial court is also directed to record the statement of the prosecutrix NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6580 2 MCRC-55912-2024 and her parents within 30 days from receiving of the copy of this order.
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Banti vs The State Of M.P. on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53555304/
